definition: Public checkpoints measured under one set of definitions: bits of the entropy-coded payload over the original image area, PSNR of the 8-bit RGB reconstruction cropped to the original size, each release's own padding, arithmetic mean over images.

extra.note: DIV2K and MS-SSIM come from the confirmation batch, which measured seven of the eight releases (LALIC was not measured). MS-SSIM is a sensitivity analysis: the windows follow the same rule as DIV2K and are not part of the frozen protocol.
